drafts.title: Cranberries harvested under solar panels. Palisade peaches next?
drafts.angle: Solar that helps farm families, with a Western Slope hook and his own solar numbers as proof.
bullets: Massachusetts has two cranberry bogs harvested under working solar panels, believed to be the first in the US (Canary Media).
Kingston: 4.4 MW of solar with a 13.5 MWh battery; Plymouth: 1 MW.
Panels are raised so farm equipment fits under them; pilings went far deeper than usual in bog ground.
A state farm official called it a farm viability opportunity.
